item.text:
Verdict: mostly no, with a narrow positive exception for war-economy output and a few targeted service programs. The 2024 outcome picture was mixed at the top line but weak on broad welfare, peace, and institutional quality. Growth and low unemployment improved, but they were heavily driven by military production; inflation, war costs, repression, and civilian harm all moved the wrong way.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level note | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Russian economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | Reuters reported broad growth and record-low unemployment in 2024, which is the clearest positive outcome relative to Putin’s economic claims. The same piece says the growth was driven largely by military production, so this is a real improvement but a war-skewed one. | 8B.7; also 8B.3, 8B.6 |
| Positive | [Universal free medical care for 2024-2026](https://government.ru/news/50600/) | Government of Russia | 2024-01-09 | https://government.ru/news/50600/ | The government kept a universal health entitlement in force, including high-tech and specialized treatment. This is a concrete welfare outcome, though it is a baseline safeguard rather than evidence of a major health improvement. | 8B.7; also 8B.6 |
| Positive | [Annual family benefit for households with two or more children](https://government.ru/docs/all/154255/) | Government of Russia | 2024-07-13 | https://government.ru/docs/all/154255/ | Russia created a nationwide cash benefit for eligible working parents with two or more children. This is a real distributional outcome, but it is narrow and not enough by itself to show a broader population-growth turnaround. | 8B.7; also 8B.6 |
| Positive | [Medics’ pay supplements and staffing programs extended](https://government.ru/en/news/51246/) | Government of Russia | 2024-03-26 | https://government.ru/en/news/51246/ | The government said medics’ pay supplements were increased and the `Country Doctor` and `Country Paramedic` programs were extended to 2030. That is a tangible staffing outcome, and a plausible early sign of better rural service delivery. | 8B.7; also 8B.6 |
| Positive | [Rehabilitation pilot for children with disabilities](https://government.ru/docs/53649/) | Government of Russia | 2024-12-09 | https://government.ru/docs/53649/ | The rehabilitation program expanded from 3 to 38 regions and covered rehab, lodging, meals, and travel costs. This is one of the clearest 2024 social-policy outcomes moving in the claimed direction. | 8B.7; also 8B.6 |
| Positive | [Russian central bank kept rates on hold after Putin’s call for balance](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin did not simply bulldoze the central bank. Reuters said he backed tight policy while the bank held rates, which is weak but real evidence of macro-stabilization behavior under inflation pressure. | 8B.7; also 8B.6, 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Russian economy rebounds on military spending, masking wider weakness](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisrussias-gdp-boost-on-military-spending-belies-wider-economic-woes-3295688) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisrussias-gdp-boost-on-military-spending-belies-wider-economic-woes-3295688 | Reuters said the GDP rebound rested heavily on state arms production and did not translate into broad living-standard gains. That cuts against claims of durable civilian prosperity. | 8B.7; also 8B.3 |
| Negative | [Putin says Russia’s economy is overheating, inflation is worrying](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/) | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-12-19 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/ | Putin himself acknowledged overheating and high inflation. That is outcome evidence moving against the claim that the economy was on a clean, sustainable upward path. | 8B.7; also 8B.6, 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Russia prepares for further tax rises due to war](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html) | Ukrinform / Reuters | 2024-11-02 | https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html | Reuters reporting said war financing was forcing tax rises and cuts in small-business support and education development. That is an adverse outcome for the civilian side of Putin’s declared economic agenda. | 8B.7; also 8B.3, 8B.6 |
| Negative | [Russia’s human-rights situation remains bleak three years after the invasion](https://ukraine.un.org/en/286771-ukraine-human-rights-situation-remains-bleak-three-years-after-russia%E2%80%99s-full-scale-armed) | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-12-31 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/286771-ukraine-human-rights-situation-remains-bleak-three-years-after-russia%E2%80%99s-full-scale-armed | The UN said civilian casualties were still rising, executions and torture of POWs continued, and Russia was solidifying control over occupied territory. Those are outcome indicators moving opposite to any claim of humane, stabilizing war conduct. | 8B.7; also 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Moscow shooting poses awkward questions for Russia’s intelligence agencies](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/moscow-shooting-poses-awkward-questions-for-russias-intelligence-agencies-3352104) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/moscow-shooting-poses-awkward-questions-for-russias-intelligence-agencies-3352104 | Reuters said Russia’s security state was effective at detaining opponents but failed to stop the Crocus mass shooting. That is a concrete public-safety outcome moving the wrong way despite heavy coercive capacity. | 8B.7; also 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Putin-controlled aircraft deported Ukrainian children, U.S.-backed research alleges](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveputincontrolled-aircraft-deported-ukrainian-children-usbacked-research-alleges-3750835) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveputincontrolled-aircraft-deported-ukrainian-children-usbacked-research-alleges-3750835 | This is an allegation, not a judicial finding, but if accurate it is strong negative outcome evidence on child protection and forced displacement. It cuts directly against any welfare or humanitarian claim. | 8B.7; also 8B.5 |
| Mixed | [Freedom House: Russia](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House’s 2024 baseline says Russia remained “Not Free,” with concentrated power, weak accountability, and pervasive corruption. That is not a single outcome indicator, but it is the main context showing why many claimed gains were narrow, distorted, or not durable. | 8B.7; also 8B.5, 8B.6 |

Search gap: I found good 2024 evidence for GDP, unemployment, inflation, war costs, civilian harm, and a few service-delivery programs. I did not find a single independent, comprehensive 2024 outcome audit for Putin’s claimed goals on population growth, fair competition, private initiative, or technological effectiveness, so those areas remain only partially observable.
